source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 59 (IWDG) + memory map p.179
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.59 IWDG register interface + memory map p.179 (IWDG secure base 0x56004800)
target.safety_allocation: QM: owner scope SC-IWDG-QM-2026-10-21 (local-profile experiment, ASPICE evidence only)

scope: LL (header-only, static inline): read/write IWDG registers through the generated register-block array ll_iwdg_regs (extern; placed at the IWDG base by the linker, defined in RAM by host tests), indexed by the generated LL_IWDG_<REG>_OFFSET / 4U
Start the watchdog and refresh the counter by writing the documented keys to IWDG_KR; enable and disable write access to IWDG_PR, IWDG_RLR and IWDG_WINR with the documented keys
Set the prescaler (IWDG_PR.PR) and the reload value (IWDG_RLR.RL); query the update flags in IWDG_SR (PVU, RVU) and the watchdog enable status (ONF) (no waiting: the caller bounds its polling)
Out of scope: HAL API, window option (IWDG_WINR), early wake-up interrupt (IWDG_EWCR, IWDG_ICR), hardware watchdog option bytes, low-power freeze, debug freeze
